# Most consecutive football (soccer) national top division league titles (female)
![Most consecutive football \(soccer\) national top division league titles \(female\)](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/images/css/gwr-ph.jpg)
**Share**

[ Contact an Account Manager ](https://journey.guinnessworldrecords.com/contact/s/?language=en_GB) Who
    SFK 2000 Sarajevo What
     24 total number  Where
     Bosnia and Herzegovina  When
     May 2026 
The most consecutive football (soccer) national top division league titles (female) is 24, achieved by SFK 2000 Sarajevo (Bosnia and Herzegovina) from 2002/03 to 2025/26.
SFK 2000 Sarajevo have won every edition of the Premijer Ženska Liga, the top flight of Bosnia and Herzegovina women’s football, bar its inaugural season in 2001/2002.
Records change on a daily basis and are not immediately published online. For a full list of record titles, please use our Record Application Search. (You will need to register / login for access)
